assessments.name: Interactive oral assessment
assessments.description: Personalised summary discussion between student and panel about the development of their creative work over the semester. Students need to achieve a minimum of 50% in this hurdle task to pass this unit.
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 17 Jun 2026 at 09:00

assessments.name: Composition portfolio
assessments.description:
Composition portfolio with live recording(s) or computer generated rendition of score where live recording is not possible.

For CCI and DMM students a creative portfolio of works relevant to discipline focus with analytical notes/visual/score.
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 16 Jun 2026 at 23:59

assessments.name: Participation in one to one lessons
assessments.description: Ongoing participation and engagement in weekly one-to-one lessons, based on punctual attendance, regularity of work patterns, depth of compositional process and engagement in one's art form.

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task - Semester Plan
assessments.description: A written semester plan, mapping out the proposed structure and content for a portfolio of new musical compositions. The plan should include a week-by week timeline and a proposed listening/score study list.
